gates.title: wait_tasks(wait_any) always terminates
gates.invariant: No single tool call may wedge a turn: wait_any must return even for a meta-only task with no timeout supplied.
gates.oracle: waitMany(['<meta-only>'], 'wait_any') resolves in < 5s and reports the task as still running.

assertions: wait_any returns promptly for a meta-only task even with no timeout

gates.title: TypeScript compiles without errors
gates.invariant: The whole workspace type-checks; no new type error reaches main.
gates.oracle: `tsc --noEmit` exits 0 and prints zero error lines.

gates.title: Sandboxed spawns still execute the caller's command
gates.invariant: A background shell/monitor run under an active sandbox must execute the caller's own command, never a placeholder probe.
gates.oracle: sandboxWrapperArgv(command, decision) tail === command; 'true' appears nowhere in argv.

assertions: sandboxWrapperArgv > bakes the CALLER command into argv, not a probe command

gates.title: Builtin skill routing keeps its positive/negative triggers
gates.invariant: Positive triggers rank their target skill top-1; negative triggers stay below 0.15; no description collisions.
gates.oracle: router.eval.test.ts passes against the real product-content catalog (no LLM, deterministic).

assertions: positive triggers rank the target skill top-1
negative triggers stay well below positive-match strength
builtin skill descriptions do not collide

gates.title: A shell command containing quotes reaches the shell intact
gates.invariant: On Windows the whole command is one argv element; Node must hand it to cmd.exe verbatim or quotes are re-escaped and the command is silently mis-parsed.
gates.oracle: spawnShell with `node -e "console.log('QUOTED-OK')"` yields output containing QUOTED-OK instead of exiting 0 with no output.

assertions: passes a command containing quotes through to the shell intact

gates.title: Background task output on disk stays bounded
gates.invariant: A task that streams for hours must not grow output.log without limit under ~/.hip/task-output.
gates.oracle: saveOutput keeps the tail and caps the file at TASK_OUTPUT_FILE_CAP_BYTES, with a truncation notice.

assertions: saveOutput caps output.log on disk and keeps the tail

gates.title: wait_tasks clears the timeout it arms
gates.invariant: A completed wait must not leave a live timer for the rest of its timeout window — that is a handle leak per tool call.
gates.oracle: waitMany(timeoutMs=60_000) clears the handle it armed, in both wait_any and wait_all.

gates.title: A refused agent resume answers the user
gates.invariant: resumeSubagent must never `return` in silence: busy, background, and unknown-task refusals all emit an error the UI can show.
gates.oracle: Each refusal path emits exactly one error with code AGENT_BUSY / AGENT_NOT_RESUMABLE.

assertions: another turn in flight → AGENT_BUSY error

gates.title: Attachment paths cannot escape the allowed roots
gates.invariant: Both separators are path separators on Windows: `dir/sub/../x` must be rejected, and an out-of-root path must read as invalid rather than merely missing.

assertions: rejects ".." segments written with every separator the platform honours
reports INVALID_PATH for an out-of-root path even when it does not exist

gates.title: A stuck automation records one skip per reason per due slot
gates.invariant: Global concurrency cap must not write a skip row every 30s and evict the real run history.
gates.oracle: recordSkip dedupes identical (error, nextRunAt) signatures and records again once the slot or claim state changes.

assertions: recordSkip logs one row per reason per due slot

gates.title: Full unit suite is green
gates.invariant: `yarn test` must be a usable regression gate, not a wall of permanent red.
gates.oracle: `vitest run` exits 0 with zero failing tests.

knownGaps.reason: Environment-dependent expectations: macOS-only sandbox-exec assertions and ffmpeg-absent media tools. Being converted to self-skipping; until then this gate stays red on Windows.

gates.title: Rust lib tests pass
gates.invariant: The Tauri host's pure logic stays green.

knownGaps.reason: pty::tests::pty_echo_smoke hangs on Windows PTY; excluded via --skip pty.
